5789-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5789-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-3249-4976--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Open the Graves triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3967-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1981-2415-3967-6458.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-3334-7811.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Lae'zel
Repeat.

1660-7777-7778.description:
Cast Natural Affinity by paying {2}{G}, causing all lands to become 2/2 creatures in addition to their other types.
Cast Darkness Descends by paying {2}{B}{B}, putting two -1/-1 counters on each creature.
Each land dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, as well as each creature that had toughness 2 or less.
Necroskitter triggers for each creature and land your opponents controlled that died, returning them from their graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.
1660-7777-7778.notes: You can prevent your own creatures / lands from dying by also having an anthem effect that boosts their toughness on the battlefield.

1624-7439-7735.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Use Channel's ability by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

3532-3581-5078-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3581-5078-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena and Kykar trigger.
Resolve the Elena trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

676-4050-4182-7639.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creature tokens.
676-4050-4182-7639.description:
Cast Whispers of the Muse by paying {U} due to Magnus the Red.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whispers of the Muse.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1652-4069-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-4069-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

997-4681-5170-6772.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

11-2492-5195.easyPrerequisites:
You have another instant or sorcery in hand that can be cast using at most four colored mana, with valid targets (as applicable).
You have enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery minus one colored mana.
11-2492-5195.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Bonus Round.
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Bonus Round and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Bonus Round trigger, copying the instant or sorcery.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 5, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the spell from step 4.
Bonus Round and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bonus Round trigger, copying Narset's Reversal targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original spell from step 4, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the spell from step 4 and returning the original spell from step 4 to your hand.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of the spell from step 16.
Holding priority, repeat from step 4.

1824-2530-3168-7359.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1824-2530-3168-7359.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-3168-7359.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Tablet of the Guilds triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

240-5470-5686-7296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

3168-4217-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Urza's Incubator.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Urza's Incubator.
Repeat from step 3.

628-997-7188.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

1292-3117-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

969-1719-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2366-4068-5234-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4068-5234-5702.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2366-4068-5234-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

232-1235-4285-4477.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Greenwarden of Murasa.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Greenwarden of Murasa tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

57-4235-4846-4885.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4235-4846-4885.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

413-3234-3293-5411.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
413-3234-3293-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When World Shaper enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat
413-3234-3293-5411.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2457-4289-4365-5295.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2438-5263-6243.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

1987-4276-4823-5913.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-4276-4823-5913.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and Timeless Witness.
When Pinnacle Monk and Timeless Witness enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4276-4823-5913.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

273-4763-5553-6068.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Greedy Freebooter.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, targeting Koll.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2792-4222-5921-5970-6120.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Marina.
2792-4222-5921-5970-6120.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
2792-4222-5921-5970-6120.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Bottomless Pool.
Activate Freed form the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Bottomless Pool.
Bottomless Pool triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Activate Freed form the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

690-1203-5644.description:
Cast Fire Covenant by paying {1}{B}{R} and an amount of life equal to your life total minus 1, targeting any creature.
Judith triggers, giving Fire Covenant deathtouch and lifelink.
Resolve Fire Covenant, dealing damage equal to the life paid to the targeted creature and causing you to gain that much life.
Sanguine Bond triggers, dealing that much damage to target opponent.

3076-3430-4289.notablePrerequisites: Sleep-Cursed Faerie does not have summoning sickness, and does not have a stun counter on it.
3076-3430-4289.description:
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by paying {1}{U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1961-2793-4750-5089.notablePrerequisites: Karn has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1961-2793-4750-5089.description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Throne of Geth ability, putting a loyalty counter on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Flux Channeler triggers, putting a loyalty counter on Karn.
Repeat.

678-1636-1778-5098.notablePrerequisites: Grima Wormtongue does not have summoning sickness.
678-1636-1778-5098.description:
Activate Grima Wormtongue by tapping it and sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grima Wormtongue ability, causing target player to lose 1 life.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

261-2034-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W/P}.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Suture Priest's first ability triggers, causing you to gain one life.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it and Suture Priest's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

914-1350.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantmanets.
914-1350.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3062-3630-5007.notablePrerequisites: Morselhorder has at least one -1/-1 counter on it.
3062-3630-5007.description:
Activate Morselhorder by removing all -1/-1 counters from it, adding {B} for each counter removed.
Activate Wandering Mage's third ability by paying {B} and putting two -1/-1 counters on Morselhorder, preventing the next two damage dealt to you this turn.
Repeat.

1309-1987-2427-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
